Design, make and install One team from plans to installed staircase. Overview Gallery Downloads Reviews FAQ Overview Create your dream custom timber staircase. Stairs are often the first piece of furniture people see in a home, setting the architectural style and tone. Our custom range offers solid timber construction in beautiful Australian hardwoods and cutting edge design, with a wide range of stair furniture options to create a completely bespoke set of stairs. We design, build and install custom stairs for builders, architects, developers and homeowners. Our experienced team delivers the right staircase for the project, whether you want a striking open rise staircase, a modern frameless glass style, or stylish stainless steel balustrades. From idea and design through to manufacture and delivery or installation, we make the process easy. Our technical support and customer service are there every step of the way. Because every stair in our custom range is different, we’d encourage you to get in touch and talk through your plans. Design, make and install. One team, from your plans to a fitted staircase. Made to your plans We engineer your stairs from plans or architect drawings. Hand-built in-house Our own factory, our own team. Design possibilities Custom staircases made to your specifications. Construction & support Traditional stringer Classic and timeless construction Semi-cantilever Creates an open and contemporary design Full cantilever Treads create a floating look from hidden fixings Monospine Single central spine, timber or steel. Treads, risers & stringers Cut stringer (closed riser) Sawtooth stringer with the risers closed in. Treads on show, steps solid. Full stringer (open riser) Housed stringer with open risers. Clean side, light and airy. Cut stringer (open riser) Sawtooth stringer, open risers. The most open, contemporary look. Full stringer (closed riser) Housed stringer with solid risers. Traditional and enclosed. Balustrades Frameless glass Uninterrupted glass for a clean, open outlook. Steel & Metal Powder-coated steel and metal, square or round. Timber Timber posts and rails in your choice of species. Timber screen Vertical timber battens as a feature screen or balustrade. Custom A bespoke balustrade built to your design. Wire Tensioned wire for a minimal, see-through line. Handrails, posts & finishing touches Timber handrail Solid timber, shaped to a comfortable grip. Steel handrail Powder-coated steel in the colour you choose. Integrated LED lighting Recessed strip lighting under the treads or handrail. Premium newel posts Turned or square profiles, including our Hampton style, for a classic finish. Stair safety options Flush safety bars and slip-resistant tread details. Materials Premium timber, your choice of species. You can choose from a range of premium and sustainably sourced hardwood timber species. Each brings it's own character and unique finish to your dream staircase. American Oak Warm tones. Distinctive grain. Blackbutt Golden tones. Natural grain. Eucalyptus grandis Soft pink tones. Straight grain. Merbau Rich tones. Wavy grain. Spotted gum Rich variation. Bold grain. Ready to get started? Enquire today and let us bring your dream custom timber staircase to life. Start your project Trade & specifier enquiry CRAFTMANSHIP Over forty years of staircase craft, in every step. A custom stair is part engineering, part joinery, part art. Ours are built by tradespeople who’ve done it for decades – measured precisely, finished by hand, and checked before they ever reach your site. From quoting to installation, all staff were friendly and very professional with each question and query that was posed, answered with a willing attitude. The finished product reflects the care taken… Creation Homes Sean Hewitt Project Manager May 20, 2026 Stairlock has proven to be the A class stair manufacturer in the medium density space, and always performs with an exceptional level of quality and service. Metricon Townliving Mario Christodoulou Operations Manager Common questions Frequently asked questions about custom timber staircases. Do you work from our plans, or can you help with the design? Both. If you’ve got plans or architect’s drawings, we build to them. If it’s still being worked out, our team can help design the staircase to suit the space and the build. Either way, you sign off the detail before we start manufacturing. Do you install the staircase, or supply only? We install. A custom timber staircase needs specialised trade installation to fit it correctly and safely, so we handle it end to end: design, manufacture and install. Our MDF stairs are simpler to put in, so with those you’ve got the choice: install them yourself, or have us do it. Do the stairs come finished, or is that done on site? We take it up to the point the staircase is installed. Staining, sealing, painting and any floor coverings are done on site by your finisher. So we design, build and install, then hand it over ready for the finishing trades. Can you do glass and steel balustrades, or just timber? More than just timber. We do timber, glass and steel balustrades, plus wire and custom timber screen balustrades. So you can match the balustrade to the design, whether that’s a frameless glass look, a fine steel or wire detail, or a solid timber screen. Are your staircases BCA compliant? Yes. All our stair designs are made to meet the BCA and NCC, so the staircase complies with the current codes, including riser and going dimensions and balustrade heights and gaps.
